lines: In this lesson, you'll learn to use the tuner to bring every string into perfect tune.

scenes.heading: Why tuning matters
lines: Tune your guitar before every session — it's the foundation of playing well.
A tuner shows if a string is flat or sharp, so you know whether to tighten or loosen it.
Turn the tuning peg a little, pluck the string, and check again until it's right.
Small adjustments make a big difference in how your guitar sounds and feels.
Keep going — you're already making progress!
Pluck it, then turn the peg until the needle centers.
Repeat for each string, one at a time, until all are in tune.
Play a simple melody or strum some open strings — the app will listen and help you stay in tune.
